description: A failed charge is swallowed: the order is marked paid even when the gateway raised.
diff:
diff --git a/app/billing.py b/app/billing.py
--- a/app/billing.py
+++ b/app/billing.py
@@ -1,7 +1,14 @@
+import logging
+
 from app.gateway import charge
+
+log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
 
 
 def pay(order):
-    charge(order.total, order.card)
+    try:
+        charge(order.total, order.card)
+    except Exception:
+        pass
     order.status = "paid"
     return order
